title: GPT-5 lowers the cost of cell-free protein synthesis
summary_lines: An autonomous lab combining OpenAI’s GPT-5 with Ginkgo Bioworks’ cloud automation cut cell-free protein synthesis costs by 40% through closed-loop experimentation.
